title: Filipin Staining for Cholesterol Visualization in Adherent Cells
author: Himanshi Yaduvanshi
materials: Treat the cells for 04:00:00 with varying concentrations of the desired drug. Such as 2.5 millimolar (mM) Methyl-β-cyclodextrin Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #C4555 to deplete the cholesterol.
Fix the cells with 2 % (v/v) Paraformaldehyde Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #158127 (PFA) for 00:30:00 .

steps.title: Seed cells on coverslip
steps.instruction: Seed 5 × 10⁴ adherent cells (e.g., 4T1) per well onto a coverslip placed in a 24‑well plate and incubate until the cells adhere.

steps.title: Refresh culture medium
steps.instruction: Remove the existing culture medium and add fresh high‑glucose Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM) (Gibco, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Catalog #41965062).

steps.title: Glycine wash to quench PFA
steps.instruction: Wash the cells with 1.5 mg/mL glycine (Merck MilliporeSigma, Catalog #G8898) prepared in 1X PBS (Merck MilliporeSigma) for 10 minutes at 37 °C.

steps.title: Stain with Filipin III
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells with Filipin III (Santa Cruz Biotechnology, Catalog #sc-205323) at 50 mg/mL in PBS for 4 hours at 37 °C.

steps.title: Mount slides with PI
steps.instruction: Mount the coverslips using mounting medium that contains Propidium Iodide (PI) (Merck MilliporeSigma, Catalog #P4170) at 2 mg/mL.

steps.title: Acquire confocal images
steps.instruction: Image the stained cells on a confocal microscope (e.g., Zeiss LSM 880 or LSM 700) using a 63× oil‑immersion objective, capture 768 × 768‑pixel images with a 20 µm scale bar, and process the data with Zeiss ZEN 3.7 software.

steps.title: Quantify fluorescence intensity
steps.instruction: Perform densitometric analysis with ImageJ 1.53c (FIJI, NIH) and generate a graph of mean fluorescence intensity (MFI) of Filipin III versus drug concentration.
